summary.text: Cindi Duchow is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 97 since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
She chairs the Financial Institutions Committee.

paragraphs.text: Cindi Duchow earned a high school diploma from Catholic Memorial High School and a bachelor's degree in retail from the University of Wisconsin, Madison.
Her career experience includes working as a manager and fashion specialist and with her family's boating business on Lake Michigan.
Duchow served on the Town of Delafield Board of Supervisors from 2012 to 2016.

She has been a member of St. Anthony's Church, a board member of the Waukesha Youth Hockey Association and of the Kettle Moraine Curling Club, and a member of the Volunteer Service Club of Pewaukee Lake and the Pewaukee Yacht Club.
In the 2025-2026 session Duchow chairs the Financial Institutions Committee and serves on the Education, Criminal Justice and Public Safety, Insurance, and Joint Legislative Council committees.
